goal: Password storage review: slow salted hashes, no reversible storage and no plaintext in logs.
use: Password storage review: slow salted hashes, no reversible storage and no plaintext in logs. Use when code stores, checks or resets passwords.

steps.note: Find the storage. List where passwords or verifiers are written.
Check the hash. Flag fast hashes such as MD5, SHA-1 or plain SHA-256.
Check salts and cost. Each hash needs a unique salt and a work factor.
Check leaks. Flag passwords in logs, errors or analytics.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the migration path.
